title: Binary prefix value
statement: For a Boolean sequence $f:\mathbb N\to\{0,1\}$, define $V_0=0$ and, for each $i\ge0$, set $V_{i+1}=V_i+f(i)2^i$. Thus $V_i$ is the binary value of the first $i$ bits, with $f(0)$ least significant.
